# Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"), 
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not (arr <= 0).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")
    if (logp_with_result.shape[0] == 0 or logp_with_result.shape[1] == 0):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
    # Compute normalized weights
    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log probability)
    L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    L_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
    # Use stronger counterfactual baseline (min)
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    # Compute margin and keep mask
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin
